transcript.text: fridge part freezin stuff, lettuce + yoghurts frozen solid at the back. hotpoint ff. any ideas pls

For the fridge freezer, please check that the temperature is around 3–5°C for the fridge and -18°C for the freezer. Ensure the dial isn't set to its coldest position and confirm that fast-freeze or super-cool modes haven't been left on. Was a setting too cold or a fast-freeze / super-cool mode on (and have you changed it), or was it all set normally?
dial is turned right up to max/coldest, one of the kids may have moved it. no fast freeze that i know of. no thermometer btw

Please leave the fridge freezer doors closed for a day to allow it to settle at the new setting. Once that time has passed, please check the temperature of your stored items. Is the food still freezing in the fridge, or is it normal now?
havent changed it yet, its still on max. what should i turn it to?

Thanks for letting me know. No problem if you haven't had a chance yet. First the settings: the fridge should be about 3–5°C and the freezer -18°C. Check the dial isn't on its coldest setting and that fast-freeze or super-cool hasn't been left on. Was a setting too cold or a fast-freeze / super-cool mode on (and have you changed it), or was it all set normally?
its on max like i said. the food frozen is right up against the back wall near the vent slots, and the fridge is rammed after a big shop. what should i set the dial to?

Food pressed against the back wall or right in front of the cold air outlet can freeze even when the fridge is at the right temperature. Please check if any items are blocking airflow and let us know: Was the frozen food touching the back wall or a vent (and have you moved it), or was it clear?
yes it's touching the back wall right by the vent slots, and stuff is pressed against the vent. haven't moved it yet. what do i set the dial to?

Please leave the doors closed for a day to allow the appliance to settle at its new temperature setting. Once that time has passed, could you let me know if the food is still freezing in the fridge, or is it normal now?
